notes_for_editor: Two conflicts are not resolved. (1) Design and date: firelookout.com and the Forest Service list give a 1935 L-4 cab on a log crib; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a 1935 camp. Both are reported. (2) Status and kind: the FFLA list says two-story cab and gone, firelookout.com and the Forest Service list say ruins; the status correction (gone to ruins) is for human review. (3) Location: the record (FFLA) has 46.38274, -115.69049, while another Idaho list in our cache has 46.35784, -115.70049. The township, range and section (35N, 6E, sec 10) and firelookout.com's 'nine miles southeast of Pierce' should be checked against the map point before trusting it. Elevation is given as unknown ('?') by firelookout.com, so none is recorded. No staffing in any source.
